subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should OpenClaw treat current history/Stop-state reconnect mitigation as sufficient, or should it add first-class active WebChat run adoption across WebSocket reconnects?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses Gateway protocol/session state and Control UI lifecycle semantics, while the only direct PR is stale and blocked; automation should not choose the permanent reconnect contract.

options.title: Implement current-main active-run adoption
options.body: Define and land a current protocol/UI contract for restoring active run identity across reconnects, with live WebChat proof.

options.title: Revive the open recovery PR
options.body: Ask the contributor or an adopter to rebase it, move protocol work to the current package, resolve review findings, and add proof.

options.title: Accept partial mitigation
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide history refresh, in-flight projection, queued-send retry, and Stop visibility satisfy the supported behavior.

recommendation.title: Implement current-main active-run adoption
recommendation.body: Define and land a current protocol/UI contract for restoring active run identity across reconnects, with live WebChat proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current-main chat history, active-run projection, and protocol snapshot surfaces that would define the replacement contract.
